question: Can an evolved population rule improve the chapter reconstructed 5+1 MPSO when 200 peaks compete for a fixed objective-evaluation budget?
scenario: 5 dimensions, 200 conical peaks, severity 1, period 5000, correlation 0, nexcess 1, 500000 counted objective queries
development_cases: Four existing 200-peak development seed pairs, reused with the corrected engine; no historical numerical result reuse.
selection: After 50 terminal descendant slots, minimum complete valid native development mean including seed; ties by earlier generation then source SHA256. Failed terminal slots consume allocation. Session pauses never finalize selection.
fixed_target_selection: After all seven constant targets 2..8 complete four cases, minimum development mean; ties by lower numeric target. Every new/replacement subswarm starts at five; one-step resizing on detection.
fresh_comparison_condition: After campaign completion only: distinct selected native program strictly improves development mean over corrected target five. Seed best means no discovered improvement and no self comparison.
fresh_freeze_order: Freeze selected native source, baseline and independently development-selected constant source and analysis before generating 50 NEW seed pairs excluding all historical pairs. Future user-launched sessions only.
execution_aliases: Use one physical execution for established identical sources/execution rules. Preserve nominal labels and recorded proof; do not infer equivalence merely from similar mean error.
effect_direction: Negative selected-minus-reference offline error favors the selected population rule.
case_weighting: Equal weight for independent whole histories: four development histories, 50 new paired full histories for prospective fresh comparison.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: Independent environment/optimizer case pair, preserving paired outcomes together.
bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile interval of paired whole-history mean differences using numpy default_rng. Development intervals descriptive and selection-biased; 50 fresh pairs support the prespecified primary then secondary analysis.

reported_statistics: relative mean effect against reference mean
influence: Retain every case. Report largest absolute case contribution, fraction of net mean where defined, and every completed-environment contribution; no outlier removal.
behavior: Requested-target distributions at detected changes, realized-neutral-count distributions over subswarm updates, additions/removals, measured total particles and swarm counts over counted queries, query-category shares, spread of simultaneous neutral counts and how target requests differ between swarms. Give cases equal weight; pooled totals are labeled. Summarize target switches and reversals of nonzero resizing direction per persistent swarm identifier; replacement identities begin new lifetimes. Inspect selected source for global workload and history field use. Do not treat distinct swarm count as measured peak coverage.
recovery: Use saved actual query offsets after environmental boundaries. Exclude initialization environment; average environments within case then give cases equal weight. Never interpolate unrecorded immediate error.
population_trajectories: Use counted objective evaluations as time axis. Traces share a registered 100-query grid; average cases at actual common recorded queries and show within-case neutral count spread. No simulation replay.
examples: Prospectively recorded first update, first detected change and first updates reaching quarter, half and three-quarter budgets in each case. Also choose largest negative and largest positive completed-environment contributions, excluding initialization, with ties by case index then environment. These extreme examples are explicitly post hoc, not representative frequencies. Use saved counted-query traces only; retain the unfavorable example and make no replay calls.
development_interpretation: Interim, selection-biased four-history diagnostics; no final winner or fresh-test decision before 50 descendant slots and all constant controls.
fresh_interpretation: Primary comparison: evolved-minus-5+1 mean interval entirely below zero supports improvement in this condition. Only if primary supported interpret prespecified secondary evolved-minus-selected-constant. No significance stopping or retuning from partial fresh outcomes. Constant winner means population-target tuning; conditional winner does not isolate causality of adaptation.
no_automatic_extensions: Later sessions and fresh confirmation require a new user launch. No changed horizons, histories or benchmark conditions.
reference_reuse: Only corrected source-identical target-five records reused for native seed; old diameter-engine trajectory remains historical and cannot provide a corrected control score.
partial_results: Only complete valid four-case programs have interim ranks. Incomplete work remains unranked and conservatively accounted; interim best is not a frozen final selection.
scope: Prospective 50-slot resumable campaign. Session 1 at most six slots, 80 logical responses and 180 wall minutes, final 20 minutes for drain/publication. Campaign ceilings 400 responses, 400 full attempts and 200 million conservatively counted queries. No later session or fresh testing is launched automatically.
